entries.zh: 锉磨；磨利、锉光（Amolar/limar/afilar 三义并列：磨、锉、磨快）
entries.en: to grind; to file; to sharpen

entries.zh: 在磨轮（砂轮）上磨刀；车磨刀具
entries.en: to grind (a blade) on a wheel

entries.zh: 磨剃刀；汉字「唱」原稿标注疑为「喙」之讹，释义存疑
entries.en: to sharpen a razor (navaja); gloss of the Chinese character uncertain
entries.notes: source_H 带 [疑:唱/喙] 标记，词头 navaja=剃刀 17 世纪义明确，但汉字栏存疑。

entries.zh: 儆戒；告诫、训诲（词头注 q. corregir, enseñar：即纠正、教导）
entries.en: to admonish; to warn, correct, instruct
to admonish by word of mouth; to speak (reprove)

entries.zh: 讲道理；说理劝诫（天主教语境亦可指讲道）
entries.en: to reason with; to lecture, preach

entries.zh: 安抚劝谕；好言相劝（友善地告诫）
entries.en: to admonish kindly; to soothe with friendly counsel
to admonish with reason; to reason and admonish

entries.zh: 教诲晓谕；温和地教导劝诫
entries.en: to instruct gently; to teach and admonish
entries.notes: 词头 lenidad 拼写罕见（或为 lenidad=温和、或 suavidad 之讹），依「教谕」汉字取教诲义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕化谕劝化（西文词头「amonestar [残] buens」中段残缺）
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕to admonish/exhort (Spanish headword partially lost)
entries.notes: 词头含 [残]，据汉字「化谕」与对音 hua xu 推测为劝化晓谕。

entries.zh: 在教堂中训诫将行婚礼者（婚配前的训导）；汉字「叫」原稿标注疑为「叼」
entries.en: to admonish in church the one about to marry (nuptial instruction/exhortation)
entries.notes: source_H 带 [疑] 且对音栏含 T99 污损标记；语义依马尼拉天主教婚礼训导语境推断。

entries.zh: 堆；堆积（词头注 q. juntar：即聚拢）
entries.en: to heap up; to pile, gather together

entries.zh: 堆积；累积成堆〔对音污损标记，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 「積」对音含 T99 污损难辨标记，汉字与词头语义仍互证，释义方向可信但按纪律降级。

entries.zh: 心爱；真心爱（词头 Amor por amor：纯粹之爱，即爱）
entries.en: to love from the heart; to love for love's sake

entries.zh: 私自溺爱；恣意偏爱（「私己爱」：出于私意的爱）
entries.en: to love for selfish/private ends; self-directed love
entries.notes: 闽南对音仅两音节（say guiay）对三字汉字，「已」字读音对应不明，释义依汉字推定。

entries.zh: 殓；为死者整装入殓（词头 Amorrajâr 当为 amortajar 之讹写：给尸体穿衣）
entries.en: to dress and prepare a corpse (Sp. amortajar); to encoffin
entries.notes: 词头 Amorrajâr 非 standaard 西语，依 17 世纪文献惯见 amortajar（殓尸）与汉字「殮」及对音 liam 定夺。

entries.zh: 棺殓；入棺殓尸（词头注 cuerpo amortajado：已殓之尸）
entries.en: to encoffin; to place the dressed corpse in the coffin
